verdict.rationale: Sill documents an architecture with no account and no server, so screen and input data stay on the user's own devices, and it gives in-app controls to delete pairing records: remove paired devices on the Mac and Forget a paired Mac on the device. It does not document retention settings or deletion for other locally stored data such as logs; the docs only say where the logs are. missing for 10: retention policy or retention settings, documented deletion of logs and other local data, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: There is no account and no server: your screen and what you type travel only between your own devices
Sill's Settings › Devices on your Mac lists the devices you paired. Remove one you no longer use, or have lost.
To forget one Mac you paired, touch and hold its row on the connect screen and choose Forget.
